short_description: SyN as the Learn2Reg 2024 organisers ran it for LUMIR (antsRegistrationSyN[so]): cross-correlation of radius 2, from the identity, 100x70x50x20 iterations, single precision, on the ANTs 2.6.5 release binaries fetched on first use. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline ants. CPU.
description: SyN as the Learn2Reg 2024 organisers ran it for LUMIR (antsRegistrationSyN[so]): cross-correlation of radius 2, from the identity, 100x70x50x20 iterations, single precision, on the ANTs 2.6.5 release binaries fetched on first use. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline ants. CPU. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. Masks are ignored by this baseline. Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
